title: Repairs and habitability
rule: Landlords must keep rentals habitable (working plumbing, heat, weatherproofing, no pests, safe electrical). Tenants should request repairs in writing and keep dated copies. If repairs are not made in a reasonable time, tenants can file a complaint with SF Department of Building Inspection (DBI), which can inspect and issue a notice of violation. State law presumes 30 days is a reasonable time for repair-and-deduct.
confirm_with: SF DBI Housing Inspection Services or SF Tenants Union
